# Fixture provenance / Provenance des exemples

Retrieved / récupéré : 2026-11-15.

- `brampton-sidewalks.page.geojson` and `.esrijson`: City of Brampton, Sidewalks, CC BY 4.0; ArcGIS FeatureServer/0. Attribution: City of Brampton, Sidewalks, CC BY 4.0. The supplied GeoJSON contains three features despite its two-feature description.
- `toronto-pedestrian-network.page.json`: City of Toronto, Pedestrian Network, Open Government Licence – Toronto. Attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.
- `demo-kitchener-sidewalks.esrijson`: demonstration data (not real segments); City of Kitchener Open Data licence to verify.
- `demo-london-sidewalks.esrijson`: demonstration data (not real segments); City of London Open Data licence to verify.
- `demo-ottawa-pednet.esrijson`: demonstration data (not real segments); City of Ottawa Open Data Licence v2.0 to verify.

Les fichiers `demo-*` sont fictifs et ne décrivent aucun lieu réel.
